title: Illumination field measurement with photographic paper
goal: Characterize the spatial homogeneity and spread of LITOS blue light at different distances from the LED matrix.

title: Whole-well homogeneity of optoFGFR stimulation in 96-well plates (ERK-KTR imaging)
goal: Test whether four LEDs per well uniformly activate ERK in all NIH3T3 cells of a well, without spillover to adjacent wells.
unresolved_refs: image analysis pipeline established in our laboratory (ref 16)

title: pERK western blot vs ERK-KTR after optoFGFR stimulation in 6-well plates
goal: Show LITOS can stimulate enough MCF10A cells for biochemical readouts and compare pERK dynamics to ERK-KTR C/N dynamics.

title: optoRaf vs optoFGFR stimulation with light pulses of different durations
goal: Compare ERK responses of two actuators with different activation mechanisms to light inputs of varying duration.

title: Small drug screen of MAPK inhibitors on optoFGFR-induced ERK dynamics

title: High temporal resolution ERK dynamics after a single 2 s pulse
goal: Capture fine ERK activation and adaptation dynamics with 1 min fixation resolution.

title: Pulsatile vs sustained ERK dynamics with high- and low-frequency light pulses
goal: Demonstrate complex stimulation patterns (10 s pulses every 2 or 20 min for 84 min) evoking sustained or pulsatile ERK dynamics.
